name: zellij-indicator-felix
description: Vendored fork of opencode-zellij-indicator@0.7.0 (v0.7.0, aidan-gallagher, MIT). Patches: compact tabs by default (status icon only, so the Zellij tab shows just its index + icon); set OPENCODE_ZELLIJ_TITLE_MAX > 0 to show titles, adaptively budgeted to the status bar (format.ts adaptiveTitleMax). Drop this vendored copy when upstream ships truncation.
author: Aidan Gallagher
